# DonorDock Online Giving

Yes, **DonorDock does offer online giving** capabilities through their platform called **DonorDock Giving**.

## Key Features:

- **Donation forms** - Customizable online donation pages
- **Recurring giving** - Support for monthly/ongoing donations
- **Embedded forms** - Can be integrated into your website
- **Mobile-optimized** - Works on smartphones and tablets
- **Payment processing** - Accepts credit cards and ACH transfers
- **Donor management integration** - Donations automatically sync with donor records

## Pricing Note:
DonorDock Giving typically involves payment processing fees (similar to other online giving platforms), which are separate from their CRM subscription costs.

This makes DonorDock an all-in-one solution where you can manage both donor relationships and online fundraising in the same system.
